rcmp.caption:
Thinking about a career with the RCMP?  Want to check your fitness levels? 

Join us for a Police Fitness Assessment Field Exposure Workshop and see how your fitness measures up to the physical demands of policing.

Participants will learn about common physical tasks required of RCMP officers, explore realistic training scenarios, and gain a better understanding of the fitness benchmarks expected at the RCMP's National Depot Training Academy. This voluntary session will be conducted in English.

 October 30, 2026
 ⏰ Session 1: 9:30 a.m.
 ⏰ Session 2: 1:00 p.m.

 To register, email PEIrecruiting-recrutementIPE@rcmp-grc.gc.ca and indicate your preferred session.

⚠️ Spots are limited!

Location details and preparation guidelines will be provided upon registration.

#PEIRCMP #RCMPRecruiting #CareerInPolicing #JoinRCMP #PoliceFitness
